novel.title: The Perfect Run III
novel.summary: Ryan Romano, an immortal time-looper known as Quicksave, enters what he hopes will be his final loop in New Rome. Armed with centuries of knowledge and the ability to freeze and reset time, he must dismantle three converging catastrophes: the Meta-Gang under the cannibal warlord Big Fat Adam, the criminal empire of the god-like tyrant Augustus, and the bioweapon threat posed by Bloodstream — his adoptive father, now a living viral plague. Alongside allies he has painstakingly recruited across dozens of loops — including the Augusti princess Livia, his adoptive sister Len, the Carnival heroes, and a rotating cast of reformed Psychos — Ryan pursues a 'Perfect Run' that saves everyone while finally allowing himself to find love, family, and a reason to live.
themes: the nature of time and causality

characters.name: Ryan Romano
characters.age: Appears late 20s; chronologically over 900 years old due to looping
characters.description: A handsome man who favors a trenchcoat, bowler hat, and mask. Wears the Saturn power armor in combat — a grey suit with ear-like antennae. His face is rarely seen without his mask in public.
characters.personality: Witty, sarcastic, and relentlessly comedic even in dire circumstances, masking centuries of loneliness and trauma. Deeply loyal to those he loves. Gradually re-learns to open his heart across loops. Obsessively protective of his Plymouth Fury and cashmere suits.
characters.background: A courier in the post-Genome War world, Ryan gained his Violet Elixir power after wishing to die, granting him chronokinesis. He has spent centuries in time-loops, initially numbing his emotional pain with adrenaline and entertainment. He came to New Rome looking for Len Sabino, his amnesiac adoptive sister, and found instead the love of his life and a cause worth fighting for.
characters.current_power_level: Violet Genome (chronokinetic) with secondary Black Flux ability

power_progression.stage: Black Flux fully manifested vs Augustus

special_abilities: Time Stop (Quicksave): freezes time for everyone except himself and those he moves
Black Flux: destructive particles that erase causality and can permanently destroy entities across timelines — requires Saturn Armor to manifest fully
Enhanced timing sense: body continues operating on autopilot even when mind is overwhelmed
Save/Reset: upon death restores to a fixed save point, retaining memories
Cannot be detected in frozen time by most Genomes; Augustus is an exception

characters.name: Livia Augusti
characters.description: Pale skin, platinum silver hair, and blue eyes. Slender and often dressed in black coats or elegant dark ensembles. At the novel's end she wears the Opis power armor — red plates with black visor and eight steel tentacles, bearing a white spider symbol on the chest.
characters.personality: Highly intelligent, calculating, and deeply empathetic beneath a composed exterior. A natural strategist with a sharp tongue and an unexpected sense of humor. Struggles with guilt over her father's crimes but possesses tremendous moral courage. Laughs at inappropriate moments, which Ryan finds endearing.
characters.background: Eldest daughter of Augustus, the most powerful warlord in Europe. Born with Blue precognitive powers and a secondary Violet time-skip ability, she works from within the Augusti empire to reform or dismantle it. Her mother Juno was accidentally killed by Leo Hargraves. She independently deduced Ryan's time-looping ability and became his most important ally and romantic partner.
special_abilities: Blue Power: probabilistic future sight — sees most likely outcomes of actions
Secondary Violet Power: time-skip — fast-forwards a brief slice of time, forcing others to act on their 'predestined' motions while she repositions
Cannot perceive Ryan Romano — he is a blind spot in her visions
Exceptional analyst and planner; runs simulations in her head

characters.name: Len Sabino
characters.description: Wears a full power armor of her own Genius design, blue and aquatic in theme. Uses a water rifle as her primary weapon.
characters.personality: Stubborn, emotionally guarded, and prone to depression, but fiercely loyal and deeply caring. Struggles with trust due to trauma surrounding her father's fate. Gradually opens up to hope over the course of the novel.
characters.background: A Genius inventor specializing in water-based technology who built a submarine (the Laïka) and a personal power armor. She is Bloodstream's daughter, carrying a blood sample of her father inside her that acts as a sleeper agent. She lost her memories of past loops, making each reconnection with Ryan a fresh challenge. By the novel's end she leads community rehabilitation efforts in Rust Town.
characters.cultivation_path: Genius (technological power, no direct Genome ability)
special_abilities: Genius intellect — creates advanced water-based weaponry and power armor
Power Armor: flight, enhanced strength, water sphere traps, pressurized water jets
Water Rifle: fires spheres of water that trap targets
Chronoradio: allows cross-time communication with Ryan

characters.name: Mathias Martel
characters.description: Wears a glass helmet and glass-plate armor of his own construction. Quiet and serious-faced beneath his mask.
characters.personality: Sharp, analytical, and deeply principled. Romantically oblivious to Fortuna's advances until it becomes undeniable. Carries the burden of his mother's legacy and prophecy. Earnest in his heroism, occasionally humorless.
characters.background: Son of the Carnival's former leader, a powerful Blue seer who fell ill. Mathias took over much of her responsibilities. A game designer by trade before becoming a vigilante. He deduced Ryan's chronokinetic nature through careful observation and became one of his most trusted allies.
special_abilities: Glass manipulation: can create, shape, fly on, and weaponize glass shards
Glass armor: wear and project glass as defensive and offensive material
Flight via glass constructs
Can remove his glass helmet with his power

characters.name: Fortuna Veran
characters.description: Radiates a golden shroud of probability manipulation when her power is active. Confident and extravagantly self-assured.
characters.personality: Hilariously oblivious to sarcasm and utterly convinced of her own irresistibility and the inevitability of her desires. Warm, loyal, and protective of her siblings. Completely certain she will marry Mathias, which she announces without asking him.
characters.background: Livia's younger sister and an Augusti princess, raised as part of the Veran branch. A Genome with probability manipulation powers. She and Mathias develop a romantic relationship across the novel's events.
special_abilities: Probability manipulation: subtly adjusts outcomes in her favor, making attacks miss and allies succeed
Golden aura visible when power is active
Water rifle marksmanship augmented by her luck power

characters.name: Felix Veran
characters.description: Beautiful, smooth-skinned young man whose skin glitters under light. Half-brother of Livia and Fortuna; son of Mars and Venus.
characters.personality: Burning with idealism and desire for justice, occasionally reckless. Deeply hurt by his parents' willingness to murder him for the sake of family politics. Kind-hearted and brave.
characters.background: Son of Mars and Venus, raised as an Augusti prince. Works for Dynamis as an employee under Blackthorn. His power of explosion-touch led to the alias Atom Cat. Ryan uses him as an ally and sidekick, calling him 'kitten.' His explosive power is dangerous in populated areas.
special_abilities: Atom Cat power: can trigger explosive reactions by touching objects or people
Touch-based kinetic energy release

characters.name: Leo Hargraves
characters.description: A radiant, handsome man who emits intense light and heat. His body literally glows like a sun, and he can dim or amplify this at will.
characters.personality: Noble, empathetic, deeply compassionate, and burdened by guilt over past mistakes — particularly the accidental death of Juno, Livia's mother. A true believer in second chances and the rule of law. Strategic and cautious in battle.
characters.background: Leader of the Carnival, the world's foremost superhero organization. A Red Genome who can generate and control solar energy. He accidentally killed Juno during a conflict with Augustus. He knew the Costa family (Narcinia's true parents) and carries guilt over their death. Deeply respected by Ryan as a role model figure.
special_abilities: Solar energy generation and projection (heat, light, radiation)
Flight via gravity control
Self-sustaining — does not need to eat or breathe
Can go supernova — massive destructive energy release; insufficient to defeat Augustus alone

characters.name: Augustus
characters.description: An ivory-skinned, white-haired man with blue eyes who has been transformed by his Elixir into something resembling a living statue. His body is composed of adamantine — a metal from the Orange World — making him functionally invincible. Crimson lightning perpetually crackles around his face. Enormously tall and built.
characters.personality: Coldly arrogant, supremely confident in his own power, and utterly convinced of his superiority. Genuinely loves his daughter Livia but expresses it through possessiveness and violence. A deranged warlord who believes in strength above all else. Terminally ill, which makes him increasingly desperate and dangerous.
characters.background: Former Camorra boss who seized power across Europe after the Genome War. Built the Augusti criminal empire and established himself as the closest thing to a god on Earth. His body has been transformed into adamantine (an Orange World metal), making him immune to virtually all harm, time manipulation, and most Genome powers. Has a terminal brain tumor that reality itself is slowly rejecting. Killed the Costa family (Narcinia's parents) and imprisoned Freddie Sabino in Dynamis.
characters.cultivation_path: Orange Elixir (matter) — body converted to adamantine metal
special_abilities: Adamantine body: immune to physical damage, time-stop, most energy attacks, and biological processes
Crimson lightning generation and projection
Flight via ionized wind streams
Can perceive electron activity — detected Ryan's time-stop by watching brain electrons
Survives supernovas, nuclear detonations, and conceptual attacks from most Genomes

characters.name: Adam (Hannifat Lecter)
characters.description: A massively obese man with carbon-black skin, the result of his Psycho dual-power state. Carries a gravity cannon salvaged from Mechron's armory.
characters.personality: Cunning, depraved, jovial in his depravity, and utterly without empathy. A cannibal who genuinely enjoys his crimes. His cheerful affect makes him more disturbing than an openly furious villain. Extraordinarily manipulative — able to weaponize others' delusions against them in seconds.
characters.background: Leader of the Meta-Gang, a faction of Psychos who seized Mechron's underground bunker. A dual-power Psycho whose carbon skin makes him extremely durable. Commands the bunker and its array of Mechron technology. Taken down in a coordinated raid by Ryan, Livia, and the Panda.
characters.current_power_level: Dual Psycho (Carbon skin + unknown second power)
special_abilities: Carbon skin: extreme physical durability, resistant to most attacks
Gravity cannon: salvaged Mechron weapon that fires slow black spheres that absorb everything in their path
Masterful manipulation: instantly adapts others' delusions to his advantage

characters.name: Psyshock
characters.description: Conceals tentacles beneath his clothes that reveal his monstrous true form. His skull leaks liquid when overwhelmed.
characters.personality: Sadistic, pedophilic, and psychologically abusive. Enjoys taunting his victims with knowledge of their trauma.
characters.background: The Meta-Gang's telepath and second-in-command. His power to brainwash and create thralls makes him a force multiplier for the entire gang. Ryan neutralizes him with a Bliss inhaler early in the final loop, killing him with Cancel's cooperation.
special_abilities: Telepathy and mind control: creates long-term thralls from victims
Tentacle appendages hidden beneath clothes
Psychic network: death causes all thralls to collapse simultaneously

characters.name: Timmy
characters.description: In human form, a young man with an earnest expression. In transformed form, a seven-hundred-kilogram manbear with panda markings, enormous claws, and terrifying strength.
characters.personality: Enthusiastically heroic, immensely good-natured, and almost adorably naive. Names all of his attacks. Refers to himself in the third person. Deeply loyal to his 'Sifu' (Ryan). His innocence provides a constant ray of warmth in grim situations.
characters.background: An independent hero Ryan recruited via phone, promising him a chance to join a traveling circus/superhero team. Transforms into a giant manbear and is one of the most physically powerful allies on Ryan's team. By the novel's end, he is accepted into Mr. Wave and the Carnival's circle.
special_abilities: Manbear transformation: shifts into a 700kg bear-humanoid with enormous strength and durability
Claws and physical combat; attacks announced by name ('Spring Roll Attack!')
Genius-level profiling and behavioral science knowledge
Cracked the Alchemist's computer password through psychological profiling

characters.name: Bianca
characters.description: A young woman in shaggy jeans and a tank top. Her gaseous form is an orange-colored cloud that, after being cured, no longer corrodes metal.
characters.personality: Blunt, foul-mouthed, tough, and surprisingly sentimental beneath her exterior. Deep loyalty to Ryan for giving her her life back. Chain-smoker.
characters.background: A Psycho formerly called Sarin whose real name Ryan discovers is Bianca. She had the power to generate toxic, corrosive gas (evoking the chemical weapon Sarin). In a previous loop's Meta-Gang run, she served as Ryan's VP and sacrificed herself to delay Fallout. Ryan transfers her memories forward, restoring her to herself. After the Psycho cure, her gas is no longer corrosive.
characters.current_power_level: Dual Genome (cured Psycho): gaseous transformation + shockwave
special_abilities: Gaseous transformation: switches between human form and orange mist; can infiltrate confined spaces
Shockwave generation (secondary power)
Post-cure: gas is non-corrosive; can still create suffocation hazard

characters.name: Helen
characters.description: A Psycho who generates toxic acid rain and can teleport short distances.
characters.personality: Hot-tempered, violent, and foul-mouthed. After being cured, her mood lightens considerably. Her time in Rust Town community service is accepted begrudgingly.
characters.background: A Meta-Gang Psycho and teleporter who fought Ryan's group during the Junkyard raid. Captured and eventually cured of the Psycho condition. By the novel's end she is doing community service alongside the other cured Meta-Gang members.
special_abilities: Acid rain generation: summons caustic rainfall from localized clouds
Short-range teleportation

characters.name: Vulcan
characters.description: A dwarf woman who pilots a large, bulky mech of her own construction. Her tech is among the most advanced in Europe. By the novel's end she wears a new red power armor and joins the legitimate superhero team.
characters.personality: Fiercely competitive, biting in her humor, and businesslike. Secretly wants allies and connection but expresses it through mutual insult-trading. Ryan is one of the few people she genuinely respects.
characters.background: An Olympian of the Augusti empire but primarily a Genius inventor. She oversees Ischia Island's defenses and produces Vulcan-made weapons for the Augusti. She was once the same person as Jasmine (Ryan's past love) but in this timeline exists without those memories. Ryan maintains careful emotional distance to avoid comparing her to the past.
special_abilities: Genius-level engineering and weapons manufacture
Bulky combat mech: heavy armor, crimson beam weapon, missile batteries
Turret networks and island defense systems
New red power armor (post-epilogue)

characters.name: Enrique Manada
characters.description: A stoic, well-dressed man with plant-based Genome powers. His office is filled with living plants that subtly reflect his emotions.
characters.personality: Idealistic and deeply principled but paralyzed by family loyalty. Genuinely wants to make Dynamis into a force for good. Eventually finds the courage to act when confronted with the full scope of Bloodstream's threat.
characters.background: Manager of Dynamis's Il Migliore branch. Son of Hector Manada and brother of Alphonse (Fallout). His power is plant manipulation. He suspected his family's corruption but was too bound by love to act. Ryan convinces him to turn against his father and brother and hand over the Gravity Gun data. He ends up heading a new legitimate superhero team.
special_abilities: Plant manipulation: commands and accelerates plant growth in his vicinity
Emotional tell — plants in his office shift with his feelings

characters.name: Alphonse Manada
characters.description: A Dynamis scientist and executive who dreamed of giving every human a Genome power.
characters.personality: Fanatical and idealistic in a dangerous way. Willing to risk a global pandemic to realize his dream of universal Genome elevation. Cannot accept failure of his life's work.
characters.background: Head of Dynamis research and creator of the Knockoff Elixirs — diluted, unstable copies of true Elixirs distributed commercially. His project unwittingly created a vector for Bloodstream's global pandemic. By the novel's end he is exiled to space, floating in orbit as punishment.
special_abilities: Radiation generation and projection
Body emits lethal radioactive energy at full power

characters.name: Hector Manada
characters.description: The chairman of Dynamis corporation. An ineffectual leader whose corruption enabled his son Alphonse's dangerous experiments.
characters.personality: Corrupt, self-serving, and more interested in power than principle. Writes letters from prison to Enrique begging for an appeal.
characters.background: Nominal head of Dynamis. Conspired with Hannifat Lecter and allowed the Knockoff Elixir program to proceed despite its dangers. Arrested and imprisoned by the novel's end.

characters.name: Eva Fabre
characters.description: A scientist who fused with a Blue alien ooze aboard a crashed alien ship in Antarctica. Her body is no longer fully human — she exists simultaneously as herself and countless copies, a fractal consciousness.
characters.personality: Coldly rational, amoral, obsessed with the evolution of humanity into a higher form (Homo Novus). Views herself as a god-architect. Created Elixirs as bridges between humans and the Ultimate Ones. Driven mad by the fusion.
characters.background: A French geneticist who discovered a crashed alien ship in Antarctica years before the novel. She encountered an alien Blue ooze (a sentient Elixir) that fused with her, splitting her into multiple copies and granting her the ability to create Elixirs. She distributed these Elixirs across the world through the 'Last Easter' event, triggering the Genome War. Her facility is discovered and destroyed by Ryan's team. By the novel's end she is dead or wishes she were.
special_abilities: Elixir creation — can manufacture Elixirs of all colors using alien technology
Mind-fractal: exists as multiple simultaneous copies
Genius-level genetics, quantum physics, and alien technology knowledge

characters.name: Freddie Sabino
characters.description: No longer fully humanoid; exists primarily as a viral entity capable of replicating through blood contact. The core of his consciousness may still exist within his biological mass.
characters.personality: Whatever humanity remains in him is obscured by the virus's drive to expand and replicate. He glimpsed the Green World in his dreams long ago, which drove him toward his monstrous transformation.
characters.background: Len Sabino's father. A good man before the Genome War, he was captured by Dynamis and subjected to experiments that transformed him into a living virus — the most dangerous Psycho in the world. A piece of him lives in Len's blood, acting as a sleeper agent. If Len approaches her father, the fragment transforms her into a Bloodstream clone. The Carnival previously tried to kill him but failed. His fate is ultimately decided by Len: she chooses to attempt the cure, and if it fails, to end his suffering.
special_abilities: Viral replication: can convert anyone who consumed a Knockoff Elixir into a clone of himself upon full awakening
Blood fragment: piece of himself in Len's blood serves as a tracker and potential transformation trigger
Potential to achieve autonomous mutation and spread

characters.name: Narcinia (Giulia Costa)
characters.description: A teenage girl with brown hair and a heart-shaped face. Creates extraordinary flowers and plants. Carries freckles inherited from her mother.
characters.personality: Naive, warm-hearted, and genuinely talented. Her faith in her adoptive family is shattered by the truth of her parents' murder. Gradually reclaims her identity as Giulia Costa.
characters.background: Believed to be the adopted daughter of Mars and Venus, actually the kidnapped daughter of Bruno and Julie Costa — heroes murdered by Augustus. Her mind was shattered by Bacchus to erase the memory of her real family. Her true power (plant life creation from her Green Genome mother) allows her to create hybrid flowers and potentially feed millions. By the novel's end she is planting a garden greenhouse over Europe's ruins.
characters.cultivation_path: Green Elixir (inherited from mother Julie Costa)
special_abilities: Life creation: creates new hybrid plant species
Plants are edible, beautiful, and potentially capable of singing/emitting colored fumes per Ryan's suggestion
Power may interfere with Venus's shapeshifting

characters.name: Andreas Torque
characters.description: A gaunt, hunchbacked man in priestly garb who never blinks and whose black eyes seem hollow. Uses a wooden cane. His illusions are terrifyingly vivid.
characters.personality: Softly spoken, fanatically devoted to the Blue Ultimate One, and utterly mad. Believes torture is a path to divine ascension. Underneath the madness is a man whose psyche was shattered when the Blue Elixir overwhelmed him — he genuinely wants to escape this reality.
characters.background: An Olympian who serves as a Bliss Factory overseer and religious zealot. His Blue power allows him to project reality-bending illusions that fool all senses, including pain. He tortured Narcinia (Giulia Costa) to erase her true identity. He also commands undead thralls using a necromantic ability. Defeated when Bianca enters his lungs and knocks him out. Spared by Ryan to be treated by Alchemo.
special_abilities: Psychic illusion: projects all-sensory hallucinations that cause real pain
Undead command: animates and directs corpses as thralls, disguising them with illusions
His illusions are ineffective against creatures with no brain (e.g., Bianca in gas form)

characters.name: Laura
characters.description: A woman who can transform into a massive dragon with thick scales, fire breath, regenerating eyes, and a powerful tail.
characters.personality: Principled, brave, and deeply conflicted about her role in Dynamis. Resigns when she can no longer ignore the company's crimes. Past romantic history with Enrique Manada.
characters.background: A Dynamis security operative who serves as a Private Security force dragon. Works with Wyvern to police New Rome's Strip district. She eventually joins Enrique Manada's reformed superhero team.
special_abilities: Dragon transformation: massive scaled form with fire breath, flight, and extreme physical durability
Regeneration: eyes regrow from sword damage mid-battle
Tail and claw combat

characters.name: Mr. Wave
characters.description: A man whose head and presence radiate light like a living wavelength — he is literally a being of light. Wears a cashmere suit of impeccable taste. Former comedian.
characters.personality: Boastful, flamboyant, and endlessly theatrical — but every boast is backed up by power. Genuinely caring beneath the performance; serves as an emotional anchor for the Carnival. Ryan's childhood hero and role model.
characters.background: A legendary Carnival member and Ryan's personal hero since childhood. A Red/energy Genome who travels at near-lightspeed. He was a stand-up comedian before becoming a superhero. Gave Ryan the inspiration to become someone worth admiring. Ryan finally thanks him in person at the submarine debriefing.
special_abilities: Light-speed travel (or close to it)
Laser projection
Mixology: creates cocktails that feel alcoholic even without alcohol ('Virgin Wavemojito')

characters.name: Ki-Jung
characters.description: A beautiful Japanese woman in a tight blue costume with a badge and a hat. Works as a Private Security officer.
characters.personality: Stylish, authoritative, and elegantly competent. Ryan is not-so-secretly infatuated with her fashion sense.
characters.background: A Genome whose power relates to clothing — she can stop vehicles and assert authority over anything mechanical or wearable using a whistle. Works alongside Jamie Cutter and Lanka. By the novel's end she designs new uniforms for the reformed superhero team.
special_abilities: Clothing authority: can force vehicles and clothing-adjacent objects to obey her whistle command
Stops cars, motorcycles, and bikes in place with a single whistle blast
Master fashion designer

characters.name: Ghoul
characters.description: A skeletal undead figure. Ryan crashes into him with his car to start every loop as a ritual warmup.
characters.personality: Murderous but cowardly when confronted directly. Terrified of Ryan.
characters.background: An undead Psycho who serves the Meta-Gang. Ryan uses him as a stress-relief target at the start of each loop. He is eventually captured and sentenced to eternal imprisonment in a space cell, where he screams for eternity.
special_abilities: Undeath — survives physical harm that would kill a normal person

characters.name: Richard Pinkman
characters.description: A pallid, raven-haired scarecrow of a man who lives in darkness with condemned windows. Looks like a vampire.
characters.personality: Paranoid and violent. His power makes him dangerous to unsuspecting victims.
characters.background: A hitman with the power to manifest nightmares as reality — making hallucinated fears physically real. Ryan visits and punches him at the start of the loop to prevent him from using his power on Ryan later.
special_abilities: Fear manifestation: makes victims' nightmares real

characters.name: Mars
characters.description: A Roman centurion aesthetic Genome who summons weapons and vehicles from thin air. Wears Roman armor over a modern combat style.
characters.personality: Ruthless, decisive, and utterly without mercy toward civilians. Willing to murder bystanders without hesitation.
characters.background: One of the Olympians and father of Felix and Fortuna. He and Venus tried to murder Felix during the Black Dinner. Pursues Ryan and Felix in a vicious car chase. Imprisoned by the novel's end in an underwater prison.
special_abilities: Materialization: summons any object within 10-meter radius — weapons, vehicles, bombs, shields
Teleportation of materialized objects up to ~1000-meter range
Air-pressure shockwave boots: teleports pressurized air beneath feet for propulsion/flight
Instantaneous vehicle repair by swapping damaged components

characters.name: Venus
characters.description: An Olympian with body-manipulation powers. Raised Narcinia as an adopted daughter after the girl's true parents were murdered.
characters.personality: Vain and status-obsessed. Willingly conspired to murder Felix on Augustus' orders.
characters.background: An Olympian and wife of Mars. Her power relates to biological manipulation — possibly body shapeshifting. Captured and imprisoned by the novel's end in the underwater prison she shares with Mars.
special_abilities: Body manipulation (specifics unstated; likely shapeshifting or biological alteration)

characters.name: Silvio
characters.description: Augustus' brother and the most reasonable of the Olympians. Described as the only sensible head among Augustus' close collaborators.
characters.personality: Level-headed, genuinely decent, and willing to quietly enable Livia's rebellion when it serves peace.
characters.background: An Olympian who secretly sympathizes with Livia's desire for reform. He sends the guards away before the novel's climactic meeting, enabling Livia to meet her allies. Probably retains his position as the Augusti reorganize into something more legitimate.
special_abilities: Water-based power (specifics unstated)

characters.name: Mercury
characters.description: An ancient hunchbacked man in a cashmere suit and bowler hat, needing a wooden cane. Warts cover his face. Commands undead bodyguards.
characters.personality: Devoted entirely to the Augusti organization; served it even before Augustus transformed it from Camorra. Refuses to let it fall.
characters.background: A veteran Caporegime of the Augusti who commands undead with a necromancy-adjacent power. Oversees the Bliss Factory operations. Punched unconscious by Ryan with a single gauntlet blow, which drops all his undead simultaneously.
special_abilities: Undead command: animates and controls multiple corpses as bodyguards; all collapse when Mercury loses consciousness

characters.name: Pluto
characters.description: An Olympian with death-touch abilities. Commands the Killer Seven.
characters.personality: Scowling, cold, and professional.
characters.background: An Olympian who commands Augustus's elite assassination squad, the Killer Seven. She oversees the Bliss Factory's security after an alarm is raised. Captured in the final raid.
special_abilities: Death power (touch or proximity-based; can register living beings and end their life force)

characters.name: Geist
characters.description: A ghostly, house-sized flying skull surrounded by a tornado of colored dust.
characters.personality: Casual, laconic, and surprisingly chill about the state of the world. Bet money on Ryan winning a race.
characters.background: An Olympian with a spectral form. Can manifest his enormous skull anywhere on Ischia Island and detect living beings from great distances. Ryan killed him permanently across multiple timelines using Black Flux, making his destruction final and irreversible.
special_abilities: Spectral manifestation: giant skull can appear anywhere on the island
Distant sensory detection
Colored dust tornado

characters.name: Dr. Stitch
characters.description: A Carnival Genius specializing in viruses and illness. Scribbles notes constantly.
characters.personality: Clinical, analytical, and willing to do unsavory work for the right cause. Uncomfortable around Bianca's flirting.
characters.background: The Carnival's biomedical Genius. Already studied Bloodstream prior to the novel's events. Ryan plans to use him to develop a weapon from a vaccine sample to neutralize Bloodstream. He eventually co-creates the Psycho cure with the team's combined resources.
special_abilities: Genius-level viral engineering and epidemiology

characters.name: Frank
characters.description: An enormous iron-skinned giant who serves Big Fat Adam as bodyguard. His footsteps shake entire buildings.
characters.personality: Delusional — believes himself a Secret Service agent defending the president. Big Fat Adam weaponizes this delusion.
characters.background: A dual Psycho with iron-absorption abilities — he can absorb metal to boost his own mass and strength. Crucially, his ability to absorb metals extends to Augustus's adamantine body, making him theoretically the only conventional Genome who can harm Lightning Butt. Serves Adam as a 'Secret Service agent' defending the 'president.'
special_abilities: Iron/metal absorption: can absorb metallic substances into his body to increase mass and strength
This ability extends conceptually to adamantine, making him uniquely effective against Augustus

characters.name: Alchemo
characters.description: A Genius healer who tends to mentally ill patients. Gruff and sarcastic in his interactions with Ryan.
characters.personality: Snarky, critical of Ryan's recklessness, but ultimately caring. His moral growth across loops — including earning Ryan's forgiveness — is noted.
characters.background: A Genius specialized in mental health treatment and possibly Psycho condition research. Has a history with Ryan across many loops — including making mistakes that cost Ryan trust. By the novel's end he works in a Danish hospital tending mentally ill patients alongside the Doll.
special_abilities: Genius-level medical and psychiatric treatment

characters.name: The Doll
characters.description: A woman described as 'curious and playful' in Ryan's recollection of past relationships. Dresses as a nurse.
characters.personality: Curious and playful; tends to patients with warmth.
characters.background: A minor recurring character associated with Alchemo. Seen in the epilogue tending to mentally ill patients in a Danish hospital alongside Alchemo.

characters.name: Mortimer
characters.description: A hitman who can phase through solid matter. Uses a shotgun.
characters.personality: Professional and lethal.
characters.background: An Augusti hitman with phasing abilities. Pursues Ryan and Felix during the car chase. Crashes his motorcycle when Ryan shoots out his wheels. Imprisoned by the novel's end.
special_abilities: Matter phasing: can become intangible to pass through objects

characters.name: Sparrow
characters.description: A helmeted woman who fires laser beams. Part of the Augusti private security.
characters.personality: Professional operative.
characters.background: An Augusti hitwoman with laser ability. Pursues Ryan in the Strip car chase. Knocked out by Wyvern. Imprisoned by the novel's end.
special_abilities: Laser projection from hands

characters.name: Dr. Tyrano
characters.description: A reptilian Genius who communicates through a secure channel.
characters.personality: Pragmatic researcher. Confident in his vaccine's efficacy despite doubts from others.
characters.background: A Genius who previously studied Bloodstream and developed a vaccine. Ryan contacts him for cooperation on Knockoff research and asks about a secret 'Monster Girl' project. His vaccine is ultimately insufficient against the full threat of Bloodstream.
special_abilities: Genius-level biology and genetic research

characters.name: Vladimir
characters.description: A giant Psycho. Huge enough to punch through stone fortress walls with his bare hands.
characters.personality: Direct and physical. Gets along with the Panda. Celebrates with vodka.
characters.background: A former Meta-Gang Psycho, cured and now helping demolish the Bliss Factory. Does community service in Rust Town.
special_abilities: Super-strength and size; can punch through stone walls

characters.name: Mongrel
characters.description: More beast than man. A feral-looking Meta-Gang Psycho.
characters.personality: Animalistic and aggressive.
characters.background: A Meta-Gang member who accompanies Psyshock to the orphanage raid. Captured by Len's water sphere.
special_abilities: Bestial speed and strength

characters.name: Mosquito
characters.description: Extremely anemic-looking without special blood to sustain him.
characters.personality: Aggressive when supplied, weak when deprived.
characters.background: A Meta-Gang blood-drinking Psycho. Captured by Len's water sphere at the orphanage. Ryan previously supplied him with special blood in a past loop, which he declines to do in the final loop, leaving Mosquito weakened.
special_abilities: Blood-draining — requires special blood to maintain power

characters.name: Simon
characters.description: A Monaco survivor saved by Ryan in a previous Perfect Run.
characters.personality: Resilient and proud.
characters.background: One of the people Ryan saved from the hellish Monaco prison in a previous loop. He is seen in the epilogue planting the French flag over the Eiffel Tower's ruins alongside Martine and other Monaco survivors.

characters.name: Jerome
characters.description: A former Psycho. Happily performs community service.
characters.personality: Cheerful after curing; content with his menial work.
characters.background: A cured Meta-Gang Psycho who does community service cleaning up Rust Town. Toasts glasses with Mathias, Fortuna, and Felix in the celebration scene.

characters.name: The Land
characters.description: A Yellow/Orange dual Psycho who can fuse with and control any area of earth she stands on. When fused she appears as a disturbance in the soil. When she takes physical form she can use full terrakinesis.
characters.personality: Territorial and methodical. Silent during combat — acts through her environment.
characters.background: Meta-Gang's territorial defense. Her power gives her supreme spiritual dominion over an area, overriding Fortuna's probability manipulation in her own territory. Previously killed Fortuna in an earlier loop. Trapped inside a glass prison by Shroud after he forced her to take physical form.
characters.cultivation_path: Dual Elixir (Psycho): Yellow territory dominion + Orange terrakinesis
special_abilities: Territory dominion: gains conceptual control over any earth she merges with, overriding Yellow powers like Fortuna's
Terrakinesis: causes earthquakes and controls soil; precision inversely proportional to range
Bunker closure: ordered by Adam to seal the bunker entrance if intruders approach
Fused state: nearly impossible to destroy; must take physical form for full terrakinesis (her vulnerability)

characters.name: Gemini
characters.description: An ethereal woman of light whose body is composed of shadows. Can phase through physical matter. Her monstrous shadow chases targets.
characters.personality: Pragmatic — surrendered when the battle's outcome became clear.
characters.background: A Meta-Gang Psycho who guarded the Junkyard entrance alongside the Reptilian. Her non-flesh biology makes conventional cure attempts difficult. Surrendered after the bunker raid when she realized the battle was lost.
characters.cultivation_path: Dual Elixir (Psycho) — light and shadow based
special_abilities: Intangible shadow form: can phase through solid matter
Shadow chasing: her shadow pursues targets but with limited speed

characters.name: The Reptilian
characters.description: A reptilian-looking Meta-Gang Psycho with squinting reptilian eyes. Guards the Junkyard entrance alongside Gemini.
characters.personality: Panics when confronted with armed intruders.
characters.background: Junkyard perimeter guard. Trapped in one of Fortuna's water rifle bubbles during the bunker approach.
special_abilities: Reptilian biology — specifics unspecified

characters.name: Ink Machine
characters.description: A Meta-Gang Psycho with a body of liquid or ink. Can stretch limbs into blade shapes — demonstrated by stretching arms into axes during combat with Len.
characters.personality: Aggressive close-combat fighter.
characters.background: Meta-Gang member who fought Len Sabino inside the bunker when she breached from the sea access. Non-flesh biology makes conventional cure attempts difficult.
special_abilities: Liquid/ink body: non-flesh composition
Limb stretching: can extend and reshape body parts into weapons (axes, blades)

characters.name: Rakshasa
characters.description: A Meta-Gang Psycho who can summon demon-like gremlins faster than Len can trap them in water bubbles.
characters.personality: Unknown — seen only in combat.
characters.background: Meta-Gang member who fought Len inside the bunker alongside Ink Machine. Named after the Hindu demon.
special_abilities: Gremlin summoning: creates small demonic entities that harry and swarm opponents

characters.name: Incognito
characters.description: A Meta-Gang member with shapeshifting/impersonation abilities. Ryan used him as a decoy to provide an alibi during the Bliss Factory raid.
characters.personality: Motivated by Knockoff Elixir addiction — cooperates in exchange for a supply.
characters.background: A Meta-Gang Psycho with the ability to pose as others. Ryan infected him with Mechron-built nanites (exploding ankle-tag equivalent) to ensure compliance, then paid him with Knockoffs to impersonate Ryan at the Augusti casinos.
special_abilities: Shapeshifting / impersonation: can replicate appearance and voice of others

characters.name: Greta
characters.description: A White Genome with a power to suppress Elixir connections to their colored dimensions. Noted by Stitch as 'a White Genome among the Augusti who could help' with the Psycho cure research.
characters.personality: Professional and reliable. Executes Psyshock on command without hesitation.
characters.background: An Augusti operative and White Genome. Her power suppresses an Elixir's connection to its colored dimension. Ryan coordinates Psyshock's execution through her at the moment of the bunker raid. Present at the Venus and Mars manor dinner.
special_abilities: Elixir suppression: disconnects a Genome's Elixir from its colored world, nullifying their power
Instant kill capability — effective against targets like Psyshock

characters.name: Alice Martel
characters.description: A powerful Blue seer and original Carnival member. Now recovering from serious wounds sustained fighting Mechron. Bedridden in Denmark.
characters.personality: Methodical and prophetic. Her gift for predicting threats ranked Bloodstream above even Augustus.
characters.background: Mathias Martel's mother and the Carnival's original leader. Was nearly killed fighting Mechron. Now recovering in Denmark with her husband. Her prophecy about Bloodstream causing an extinction event drove the Carnival's urgency.
special_abilities: Future sight: provided a detailed report of global threats; ranked Bloodstream above Augustus

characters.name: Janus
characters.description: An Olympian who operates as an insider political manipulator. Named after the two-faced Roman deity.
characters.personality: Politically calculating. Instigated Felix's assassination attempt at the Black Dinner.
characters.background: An Olympian who instigated the order to murder Felix Veran at the Black Dinner. The order came from Augustus but at Janus's instigation.

characters.name: Zanbato
characters.description: An Olympian confirmed as the new Mercury at the Olympians meeting.
characters.personality: Unknown.
characters.background: Confirmed as the replacement Mercury at the Olympians meeting. Takes over Mercury's (the old one's) position within the Augusti hierarchy.

characters.name: Darkling
characters.description: A being of darkness powerful enough that Ryan believed it might be able to harm Augustus. Has returned to its home dimension — removed from causality by the Black Ultimate One.
characters.personality: Mentioned only in retrospect.
characters.background: An entity associated with the Black World, referenced as having been with Ryan previously. The Black Ultimate One told Ryan it would 'remove it from causality and all future resets.' Its departure removes one of the few conventional options for harming Augustus.
characters.current_power_level: Unknown — potentially able to harm Augustus
special_abilities: Unknown — powerful enough that Ryan considered it one of the few possible counters to Augustus

characters.name: Jasmine
characters.description: Ryan's past love from previous loops. Wild, energetic, and liked weird roleplay. No longer exists in the current timeline.
characters.personality: Wild, energetic, and adventurous — shared Ryan's sensibilities and humor.
characters.background: A woman Ryan had a deep romantic relationship with across previous loops. She no longer exists in the current timeline. She wagered her life on Ryan's success at a crucial moment. Vulcan reminds Ryan of Jasmine in some way, causing emotional pain before he learns to process it.

characters.name: Nidhogg
characters.description: A Genius and/or leader of a group pushing the boundaries of extreme medicine — potentially including resurrection research.
characters.personality: Unknown — characterized only by their research's ambition.
characters.background: Referenced by Mathias ('Nidhogg and his men haven't progressed that far yet' when discussing reviving Alice Martel beyond her current state). Commands a team doing cutting-edge medical research.
special_abilities: Cutting-edge medical Genius research

characters.name: Renesco
characters.description: The barman at the bar where Ryan ritualistically crashes his Plymouth Fury into Ghoul at the start of every loop.
characters.personality: Unsure how to react to Ryan's unforgettable entrance. Threatens to call Security.
characters.background: A recurring background character who witnesses Ryan's opening ritual every loop. Hides behind the bar counter during the chaos. Ryan considers the place a second home.

characters.name: Sarah
characters.description: A small orphan girl in the Rust Town orphanage. Found the Plushie hanging in the kitchen and came crying to Ryan.
characters.personality: Innocent and easily frightened by eldritch suicidal rabbits.
characters.background: One of the orphan children under Len Sabino's care. Discovered the Plushie's suicide attempt in the kitchen.

characters.name: Jamie Cutter
characters.description: A Private Security officer who works with Ki-Jung (Wardrobe) and Lanka. Described as so genuinely nice that Ryan wants to adopt him.
characters.personality: Warm, sincere, and genuinely kind. Invites Ryan to stay at his house even without being asked.
characters.background: A Dynamis Private Security officer who patrols the harbor and Strip. Ryan previously spent nights at his house across loops and considers him a friend worth keeping. Present at the Venus and Mars manor for the Black Dinner.

characters.name: Lanka
characters.description: A Private Security officer who works alongside Jamie Cutter and Wardrobe on the Strip.
characters.personality: Professional.
characters.background: A Dynamis Private Security officer. Ryan lists her/him among the people to reconnect with in the final loop.

characters.name: Nora
characters.description: A Genius Ryan plans to collaborate with Len on future projects — specifically underwater cities.
characters.personality: Unknown.
characters.background: Mentioned by Ryan as a Genius who could form synergies with Len. Ryan envisions Nora and Len working together to develop underwater cities in the post-crisis world.

power_system.name: Elixir System / Genome Powers
power_system.description: Elixirs are seven-colored (plus Black) biological substances created by Eva Fabre (the Alchemist) using alien technology found on a crashed extraterrestrial ship. When a human consumes an Elixir, it bonds with their biology and grants them powers drawn from the corresponding colored dimension (the 'colored worlds'). Consuming a second Elixir creates a 'Psycho' — a dual-powered but mentally unstable individual. A recent discovery by Dr. Stitch and the team has produced a cure for the Psycho condition. Elixirs are projected to vanish from circulation within ten years; future Genomes will be born rather than made.

tiers.name: Standard Genome
tiers.description: A human who has consumed one Elixir of any color, gaining powers aligned with that color's world.
power_feats: Single extraordinary ability (e.g., flight, time manipulation, solar energy)
Power scaled to individual — some Genomes are far more powerful than others of the same 'rank'
tiers.lifespan_extension: Varies by color; some (Violet, Orange) may grant extended or altered lifespan

tiers.name: Psycho (Dual Genome)
tiers.description: A human who has consumed two Elixirs, gaining two powers but losing mental stability. The instability can now be cured by a treatment developed by Dr. Stitch's team.
power_feats: Two distinct powers (e.g., carbon skin + gravity weapon, gaseous form + shockwave)
Often significantly more powerful than single Genomes
Mental degradation, delusion, and loss of empathy

tiers.name: Genius
tiers.description: A class of Genome whose power takes the form of technological superintelligence rather than a direct physical ability. Geniuses build extraordinary devices and are often the most strategically impactful figures in conflicts.
power_feats: Construction of power armors, weapons, dimensional tools, submarines
Creating cures, Elixir variants, and complex machinery
tiers.breakthrough_requirements: Consuming an Elixir that triggers the Genius manifestation

special_constitutions.name: Adamantine Body
special_constitutions.description: Augustus' body has been transformed into adamantine — a metal originating from the Orange World, the realm of pure matter. This material predates and underlies all conventional metals and cannot be affected by time, life-based powers, conventional energy, or physical force.
advantages: Immune to physical damage from any conventional source
Immune to time-stop (exists outside temporal causality)
Immune to biological and life-based powers (not 'alive' in a conventional sense)
disadvantages: Slowly degraded by reality itself rejecting the foreign material
Conceptual/metal-absorption powers (Frank the Mad) can interact with it
Livia's time-skip and Ryan's Black Flux can bypass it under specific conditions
Cannot eat or breathe, though still sleeps
special_constitutions.lore: The Orange World is described as a Rubik's cube of all matter. Adamantine sits at the center of one of its faces, surrounded by all lesser metals — implying it is the ur-metal. Augustus's Elixir bonded this substance to his body, making him a living construct of extradimensional matter.

special_constitutions.name: Violet Chronokinesis (Quicksave)
special_constitutions.description: Ryan's Violet Elixir power — granted because he wished to die — allows him to freeze time and reset existence to a fixed save point upon death. The power interprets his wish literally: he can 'die' repeatedly and return.
advantages: Black Flux secondary power can permanently erase beings across all timelines
disadvantages: Cannot control when the Elixir refuses to let him save (as in the final arc)
Black Flux requires Saturn Armor to manifest fully
Each loop erases others' memories unless memory-transfer tech is used
special_constitutions.lore: The Violet Ultimate One granted Ryan's wish to die by trapping him in an eternal recurrence — a death that resets rather than ends. As Ryan finds reasons to live, the power's nature subtly shifts to protect him and his relationships.

daos_or_paths.name: Violet Path — Time and Space
daos_or_paths.description: Violet Genomes manipulate time and space. Ryan's chronokinesis is the primary example. Livia has a secondary Violet ability (time-skip).

daos_or_paths.name: Blue Path — Information and Knowledge
daos_or_paths.description: Blue Genomes access information — futures, pasts, memories. Livia's precognition and the Alchemist's alien Blue ooze both fall here.

daos_or_paths.name: Orange Path — Matter and Material
daos_or_paths.description: Orange Genomes manipulate matter. Augustus's adamantine body and Mars's materialization both derive from this path.

daos_or_paths.name: Red Path — Energy
daos_or_paths.description: Red Genomes manipulate energy. Leo Hargraves (solar), Mr. Wave (light/speed), and Bianca's shockwave derive from this path.

daos_or_paths.name: Green Path — Life
daos_or_paths.description: Green Genomes manipulate life. Narcinia creates new plant species. Julie Costa could grant or remove life.

daos_or_paths.name: Black Path — Death and Causality Erasure
daos_or_paths.description: Black power erases causality permanently. Ryan's secondary Black Flux ability — triggered through the Saturn Armor — can destroy beings in ways that persist across all timelines.

key_changes: Ryan introduces Chronoradio, brings Ghoul for stress relief, visits Night Terror
regression_loops.outcome: Preliminary loop; testing run for bunker raid

key_changes: Memory transfers begin with Livia's help
Psycho cure discovered at the Alchemist's ship
regression_loops.outcome: The Perfect Run — all major threats neutralized, Ryan saves at the start of the loop (rare) to lock in all memories

techniques.name: Quicksave (Time Stop)
techniques.description: Ryan aligns the Purple World and Earth's dimension, creating a temporal anomaly where he alone can affect causality. All other beings freeze in place. Duration is limited and Ryan can chain multiple stops with cooldown.
effects: Freezes all non-Violet beings in place
Ryan can reposition, attack, or escape during freeze
Projectiles in flight also stop
Short cooldown between activations
weaknesses: Augustus can detect it via electron perception
Does not affect the adamantine metal of Augustus's body
Causes mental exhaustion if chained rapidly under psychic assault
techniques.lore: Ryan's time-stop works by overlapping dimensional boundaries — it is not conventional speed, but a localized pause of causality itself.

techniques.name: Black Flux
techniques.description: Destructive black particles Ryan emits that erase causality — permanently destroying what they touch across all timelines. First discovered when Ryan punched Augustus wearing the Saturn Armor.
effects: Permanently destroys targeted matter across all timelines
Can kill beings that death-and-reset loops would otherwise restore
Eradicated Geist permanently across multiple timelines
weaknesses: Requires Saturn Armor to manifest at full power
Overuse threatens to damage the space-time continuum
The Violet Ultimate One may restrict its use
techniques.origin: Black World energy channeled through Violet power; unique to Ryan
techniques.lore: The Black Particles that escaped Ryan's body at the Perfect Run's end ascended to the heavens — suggesting the power was a temporary divine loan rather than a permanent ability.

techniques.name: Time-Skip (Livia)
techniques.description: Livia fast-forwards a brief slice of time, causing all others to act out their predestined actions like sleepwalkers while she can freely reposition herself.
effects: Others act on 'predestined' physical motions during the skip
Livia can dodge attacks by positioning herself where the attack won't land
Ryan is unaffected by this — he does not act during her skip (his phase-through nature)
weaknesses: Ryan is immune — blades phase through him during a skip
techniques.lore: Livia used this technique to position herself behind Acid Rain during the bunker raid, allowing a clean water-rifle capture.

techniques.name: Blue Precognition
techniques.description: Livia sees the most probable futures of events and people. Ryan Romano is a complete blind spot — she cannot see him at all.
effects: Probabilistic future sight — shows most likely outcomes
Used to time attacks, dodge projectiles, and plan strategic operations
When close to Ryan, powers deactivate in his presence (he exists outside prediction)
weaknesses: Ryan Romano is invisible to her predictions
Powerful enough Violet distortions (saves/reloads) alter predicted futures
techniques.lore: Livia's inability to see Ryan is what first drew her interest to him — he is uniquely outside her control and prediction.

techniques.name: Supernova
techniques.description: Leo Hargraves releases his full stored solar energy in a massive explosive burst.
effects: Massive area destruction equivalent to a stellar explosion
weaknesses: Insufficient to harm Augustus's adamantine body
techniques.lore: Sunshine going supernova failed to destroy Augustus, establishing Lightning Butt as the most powerful conventional being on Earth.

techniques.name: Spring Roll Attack
techniques.description: The Panda charges at high speed in transformed bear form, rolling into enemies like a boulder.
effects: High-impact physical charge; devastating against groups and robots
weaknesses: Big Fat Adam can backhand a 700kg bear and stop him
techniques.lore: The Panda announces all his attacks by name, Spring Roll Attack being his signature opener.

techniques.name: Soaring Panda
techniques.description: The Panda launches himself into the air in an impossible floating trajectory — right leg and arms extended, left knee folded — and drives both feet into the target's head with transcendent force.
effects: Devastating head strike — knocked out Big Fat Adam with a single blow
Physically defies what a 700kg manbear should be able to do
weaknesses: Requires Blue secondary power to achieve the floating trajectory
techniques.origin: Panda's Blue-enhanced fighting style; compared to a Bruce Lee film move
techniques.lore: The first use of the Panda's Blue secondary power in combat. Ryan experienced 'religious awe' witnessing it and mentally heard a Gregorian chorus.

techniques.name: Territory Dominion
techniques.description: The Land fuses with earth in her area, gaining conceptual spiritual control that overrides Yellow probability powers like Fortuna's.
effects: Overrides Fortuna's luck power in her territory
Causes earthquakes and controls soil
Seals the bunker entrance on Adam's order
Makes The Land nearly indestructible while fused
weaknesses: Must take physical form to use full terrakinesis — exposing herself to attacks
techniques.lore: Ryan's understanding of this power helped him plan Fortuna's role: keep Fortuna away from The Land's territory and let Shroud force her to take physical form.

artifacts.name: Saturn Armor
artifacts.description: A full-body power armor built by Len Sabino and upgraded by Ryan across loops. Grey with ear-like antennae. Houses a chest-mounted weapon, jetpack, Green Flux healing system, intercom, and sensors.
abilities: Enhanced strength and durability
Jetpack flight
Chest-mounted weapon (coil cannon/Gravity Gun housing)
Green Flux healing system: passively heals the wearer
Sensor suite (electromagnetic, Flux energy detection)
Houses the Gravity Gun integration
Enables Ryan's Black Flux manifestation at full power
Intercom for communication with allies
artifacts.origin: Built by Len Sabino; iterated across many loops
artifacts.lore: The Saturn Armor is Ryan's most iconic piece of equipment. Its Green Flux healing system is a crucial survival tool, and its role in focusing Black Flux makes it essential for the final confrontation with Augustus.

artifacts.name: Opis Armor
artifacts.description: A custom power armor Ryan designed for Livia. Red as blood, black visor, white spider symbol on the chest, and eight telescopic tentacles of reinforced steel. Adapted from the Saturn model for a female wearer.
abilities: Eight telescopic steel tentacles for multi-directional combat and manipulation
Red power armor protection
Drone system controlled via the tentacles
Requires future-sight to master the full tentacle/drone array effectively
artifacts.origin: Designed by Ryan Romano, built in a Thin Place
artifacts.lore: Ryan explains the spider motif: 'Scheming and sensible like a spider.' The eight-tentacle array is nearly impossible to master without future-sight — making Livia uniquely qualified.

artifacts.name: Fisty Brothers
artifacts.description: Ryan's power-augmented brass knuckles. They allow him to channel Black Flux to a limited degree during time-stop, though full Black Flux requires the Saturn Armor.
abilities: Amplified punch force
Partial Black Flux channeling
Piston mechanism for additional impact force
artifacts.lore: Big Fat Adam's carbon skin damaged Fisty's pistons more than the reverse — highlighting the gap between Ryan's knuckles and Augustus's resistance.

artifacts.name: Chronoradio
artifacts.description: A radio device that can broadcast and receive signals across loops — playing 'songs from times that never were.' Allows Ryan to contact Len at the loop's start before she has any memory of past events.
abilities: Cross-temporal communication
Broadcasts through Violet dimensional interference
Plays music from erased timelines
artifacts.lore: The Chronoradio is Ryan's lifeline — the first tool he uses each loop to reach Len, even before establishing any other connection.

artifacts.name: Plymouth Fury
artifacts.description: Ryan's beloved 1958 Plymouth Fury automobile. Equipped with an autopilot. Has been destroyed, buried, and wrecked across dozens of loops — each time it causes Ryan genuine grief.
abilities: Autopilot navigation
Holds Ryan's arsenal in glove box and backseat
Sturdy enough for high-speed combat chases
artifacts.lore: The Plymouth Fury is treated with near-religious reverence by Ryan. Its repeated destruction by the Meta-Gang is considered by him to be among the loops' most unforgivable events.

artifacts.name: Mechron A-Bomb
artifacts.description: An atomic bomb salvaged from Mechron's arsenal. Ryan keeps it in his pocket. The Plushie eyes it hungrily during its suicidal phase.
abilities: Nuclear detonation — massive destructive yield
artifacts.lore: Ryan guarding the A-bomb from the Plushie's suicidal fascination is one of the novel's recurring dark-comedy bits.

artifacts.name: Gravity Gun
artifacts.description: A weapon that fires black spheres which function as miniature black holes — absorbing and pulling everything in their path. Salvaged from Mechron's armory; Dynamis has its own version. Integrated into the Saturn Armor's chest.
abilities: Fires slow-moving black absorption spheres that shred walls and pull matter toward them
Effective against Augustus's adamantine body (conceptually interacts with it)
Two-source technology: Mechron's bunker and Dynamis's separate development
artifacts.origin: Mechron's technology; independently developed by Dynamis
artifacts.lore: The Gravity Gun is the trump card against Augustus — the only conventional weapon with any hope of interacting with his adamantine body through conceptual rather than physical means.

artifacts.name: Resonators
artifacts.description: Devices that open and hold open dimensional portals (Thin Places). Ryan uses them to access the Alchemist's pocket dimension in Antarctica.
abilities: Opens dimensional gateways to Thin Places
Maintains portal while Ryan's group is inside
Allows communication with the outside world through a portal
artifacts.origin: Ryan's personal tech; originally built for Clown-genocide plans
artifacts.lore: The Resonators are critical for the expedition to the Alchemist's trapped pocket dimension ship.

artifacts.name: Water Rifle
artifacts.description: A handheld rifle version of Len's water weapon system. Fires spherical water bubbles that trap and drown targets.
abilities: Fires water spheres that surround and trap targets
Spheres follow targets who try to teleport away
Modified oxygen content in spheres can prevent drowning-related brain damage
artifacts.origin: Built by Len Sabino; handheld version gifted to Ryan in Ch. 3
artifacts.lore: The water rifle became a signature weapon across the bunker raid, used effectively by both Ryan and Livia.

artifacts.name: Laïka
artifacts.description: Len's custom-built submarine, named after the Soviet space dog. Carries the team on long ocean journeys including the expedition to Antarctica.
abilities: Long-range submarine travel
Autopilot with multi-country range
Houses a full crew and has a mess, medical bay, and control center
artifacts.lore: The Laïka brought Len to the Canary Islands after a mid-journey engine malfunction redirected it. Named after Laika, the first dog sent to space.

artifacts.name: Len's Power Armor
artifacts.description: Len's personal power armor with full aquatic combat capabilities. Blue-themed with water-based weaponry integration.
abilities: Full-body protection
Integrated water sphere systems
Flight and underwater movement
Sea access entry/exit capability
artifacts.lore: Len rises from the bunker's sea access in her power armor during the Meta-Gang raid — a striking introduction to her combat capability.

artifacts.name: Bahamut (Mechron's Orbital Laser)
artifacts.description: Mechron's orbital satellite weapon — an orbital laser capable of city-scale destruction. Big Fat Adam had access to it from the bunker's control room. One of Ryan's primary reasons for urgency in raiding the bunker each loop.
abilities: Orbital laser strike: mass destruction from orbit
City-scale destructive potential
Controlled from Mechron's bunker mainframe
artifacts.lore: Ryan wanted the Carnival to hunt other Mechron bases in part to potentially trigger the Bahamut to self-detonate, preventing it from ever being used.

artifacts.name: Mechron Nanites (Exploding Ankle Tag)
artifacts.description: Mechron-built nanites injected into a person's bloodstream that explode if they misbehave. Ryan used them on Incognito to ensure his cooperation as a decoy.
abilities: Bloodstream monitoring
Explosive detonation on command or upon certain behaviors
artifacts.lore: Ryan describes them as 'Mechron's version of an ankle tag, and quite effective.'

pills_and_resources.name: True Elixir
effects: Grants Genome powers aligned with the Elixir's color
Second consumption triggers Psycho condition
side_effects: Second consumption causes mental instability and dual-power Psycho state
ingredients: Alien biological substance created by Eva Fabre using extraterrestrial technology

pills_and_resources.name: Knockoff Elixir
effects: Grants partial Genome powers
Commercially distributed by Dynamis as a miracle drug
side_effects: Unstable — can act as a vector for Bloodstream's viral transformation if the full Bloodstream entity awakens
May cause mutations or partial Psycho symptoms
ingredients: Diluted True Elixir compound modified by Dynamis Genius technology

pills_and_resources.name: Bliss
effects: Powerful euphoric drug
Overwhelms the brain when delivered via inhaler — can incapacitate even superhumanly resilient targets like Psyshock
ingredients: Manufactured at the Bliss Factory on Ischia Island using alien plant compounds grown by Narcinia

pills_and_resources.name: Psycho Cure
effects: Reverses the Psycho condition
Stabilizes dual-Genome biology
Restored powers become non-corrosive (as seen with Bianca)
side_effects: Requires Genius-level resources and expertise to produce at scale
ingredients: Developed by Dr. Stitch's team using data from the Alchemist's ship and Mechron technology

pills_and_resources.name: Bliss Vaccine / Bloodstream Vaccine
effects: Airborne variant prevents Bloodstream's viral transformation from activating in Knockoff consumers
Destroys Bloodstream particles in the circulatory system
Can spread through New Rome in days, Europe in weeks via airborne delivery
side_effects: Destroys Knockoff Genome abilities in affected population
ingredients: Developed by Dr. Stitch and Dr. Tyrano from existing Bloodstream vaccine formula, using Mechron data

beasts_and_creatures.name: The Plushie
beasts_and_creatures.description: An innocent-looking white rabbit stuffed animal with big blue eyes. It is in truth a world-destroying eldritch entity from an extradimensional realm, capable of ending all life. Currently going through a suicidal phase, trying to understand death by experiencing it.
abilities: Eye-beam: fires a reality-melting energy beam by pressing its ears
World destruction capability (untested in this book)
Observes everything silently — was watching Ryan and Jasmine across multiple loops
Survives all conventional harm (cannot be killed by conventional means)
Previously attempted suicide via hanging, gunshot, drowning, and asking for Ryan's A-bomb

named_individuals.name: The Plushie
named_individuals.notes: Ryan keeps it in his possession but has no real control over it. Its off-switch was revealed to be fake.

beasts_and_creatures.lore: Augustus survived everything thrown at him — but could not survive the Plushie's gaze. It went through a suicidal phase after failing to kill Lightning Butt, trying to understand death. The Purple World finale reveals a rabbit running in a purple world in Ryan's visions, suggesting it will return.

beasts_and_creatures.name: Eugène-Henry
beasts_and_creatures.description: Ryan's aristocratic cat. Holds himself with notable dignity.
abilities: Being an aristocratic cat

named_individuals.name: Eugène-Henry
named_individuals.notes: Ryan suggested naming a hypothetical future son after him; Livia firmly vetoed this.

beasts_and_creatures.lore: Ryan's most loyal non-human companion alongside Henriette. He maintains a dignified napping schedule even during life-threatening situations.

beasts_and_creatures.name: Henriette
beasts_and_creatures.description: A bastard daughter of a mastiff and greyhound Ryan found eating trash. Blackening fur, protruding tongue, terrible stench. Ryan bought her loyalty with a ham.
abilities: Chewing on Ghoul's bones

named_individuals.name: Henriette
named_individuals.notes: Brought as psychological warfare against Ghoul, a cat person turned undead. Very effective.

beasts_and_creatures.lore: Henriette is seen in the epilogue playing with Rust Town orphans in the new green park built over the Junkyard's crater.

locations.name: New Rome
locations.description: A dazzling, neon-lit metropolis in post-Genome War Italy, built over the ruins of classical Rome. Controlled politically by the Augusti crime empire and economically by Dynamis. Divided into districts including Rust Town (slums), The Strip (casino and nightlife), Little Maghreb, and suburban areas.
locations.lore: New Rome is the primary setting of the trilogy. By the novel's end it is in the process of reconstruction under a new republic, with Livia and Enrique's organizations working together.

locations.name: Mount Augustus
locations.description: A fortified hill overlooking New Rome, topped by Augustus's personal villa — a marble temple of Roman statuary and modern comforts. Surrounded by guards and reinforced fences.
locations.lore: Augustus's bedroom contains a kitchen with statues of Roman deities in his likeness. He was found sleeping standing up, mistaken for a statue, by Ryan in the novel's most comedic scene.

locations.name: Rust Town Orphanage
locations.description: A battered orphanage in Rust Town, the industrial slum of New Rome, where Len Sabino tends to orphaned children. Has a rooftop with a view of the city's neon lights.
locations.lore: The orphanage is the emotional heart of the story. Ryan and Len have their most important conversations on its roof. Psyshock's raid on it serves as the inciting incident for the final push against the Meta-Gang.

locations.name: Mechron's Bunker (The Junkyard)
locations.description: An underground fortified bunker hidden beneath the Junkyard — a labyrinth of forking trash walls and twisted turns outside New Rome. Contains a recreational area, bar, Street Fighter arcade game, Mechron's armory, and sea access.
locations.lore: Ryan coordinates a multi-stage raid on the bunker with Livia, the Panda, Shroud, and Fortuna. The Street Fighter arcade game is tragically destroyed by Adam's gravity cannon — Ryan considers this an equivalent disaster to the Plymouth Fury's burial.

locations.name: Castello Aragonese (Bliss Factory)
locations.description: An ancient stone fortress on a volcanic islet off Ischia Island, refitted by Augustus as a Bliss drug superlab. Surrounded by alien plants grown by Narcinia. Iron walls and wind turbines contain radioactive purple miasma from the island dump.
locations.lore: The Bliss Factory is destroyed at Ryan's order — Vladimir punches through stone walls while Bianca provides shockwave assistance. Its collapse buries Bacchus's crimes.

locations.name: Ischia Island
locations.description: A radioactive island dump in the Mediterranean, surrounded by iron walls and wind turbines. Vulcan oversees its defense. The Bliss Superlab is housed in the Castello Aragonese on an adjacent volcanic islet.
locations.lore: Ryan races Vulcan around the island before the final arc, using a jetpack against her mech in a demonstration of their competitive friendship.

locations.name: The Alchemist's Ship
locations.description: A colossal alien spacecraft buried beneath the ice of Antarctica, isolated inside a pocket dimension created by Eva Fabre to imprison subjects and prevent escape. The ship's central dome is a 200-meter sphere with holographic displays of all seven colored worlds. Contains the Elixir manufacturing vats and biomechanical technology.
locations.lore: The ship predates humanity — it arrived on Earth as the site of an alien civil war. Eva Fabre discovered it decades ago and fused with its Blue alien ooze passenger. The seven-hologram display shows all the colored worlds, including one representing the Orange World's matter cube with an ivory shard — revealing the nature of Augustus's body.

locations.name: Lab Sixty-Six
locations.description: A secret Dynamis laboratory where Freddie Sabino / Bloodstream is imprisoned. The core of Dynamis's dangerous research. Its destruction is one of the key objectives of Ryan's final arc.
locations.lore: Enrique Manada visited Lab Sixty-Six and left in disgust upon learning his family's dirty secret — the lab that makes him the moral equivalent of Livia in the Dynamis organization.

locations.name: Deadland Motel
locations.description: A motel near the outskirts of New Rome where Ryan parks his car in the early loops. Named for its bleak surroundings.
locations.lore: Ryan's temporary base in early loops before he establishes himself with Livia or Len.

locations.name: The Strip
locations.description: New Rome's glitzy casino district — a four-lane boulevard bordered by luminous casinos on one side and artificial Mediterranean beaches on the other. Site of the car chase with Mars in Ch. 17.
locations.lore: The Strip car chase is one of the novel's major action set-pieces, involving Ryan, Felix, Mars, Mortimer, Sparrow, Wyvern, and Wardrobe in a high-speed battle across New Rome's nightlife district.

locations.name: Rust Town
locations.description: The industrial slum district of New Rome. Battered infrastructure and heavy Psycho crime presence. Home to the orphanage under Len Sabino's care. By the novel's end it is being rehabilitated — the Junkyard crater filled with a new green park.
locations.lore: Rust Town is the emotional heart of the story — where Ryan and Len have their most important conversations on the orphanage roof.

locations.name: Triton's Resort
locations.description: A large luxury complex on a small hill in New Rome, built between the Colosseum Maximus and Little Lilith. Glass domes and tall white spires with elevated pleasure gardens and thermal pools. Owned by the Augusti. Site of Ryan and Livia's first official date.
locations.lore: Staff members spotted Ryan kissing Livia here and spread the word across the Augusti. Statues of Venus and Mars making love at the entrance fountain.

locations.name: Mars and Venus Manor
locations.description: An English-styled manor close to Mount Augustus where Mars and Venus live. Three stories tall, grey stone and stained-glass windows. Site of the Black Dinner — a family gathering turned assassination attempt.
locations.lore: Site of the Black Dinner where Mars attempted to murder Felix on Augustus's orders at Janus's instigation.

locations.name: Len's Underwater Base
locations.description: Len's underwater laboratory and living quarters, designed as self-sufficient modular habitats (the 'Cuba Initiative') that can detach and move independently. Houses the Psycho prisoners, cure research, and Len's workshop.
locations.lore: Len has a library limited to Karl Marx and Jules Verne. Ryan is horrified she named her modular habitat system the 'Cuba Initiative.'

locations.name: Monaco
locations.description: Site of a previous Perfect Run Ryan completed before the events of this novel. He saved Simon and many others from a hellish prison there.
locations.lore: Ryan's first documented Perfect Run gave everyone a happy ending except himself — he alone remembered. Simon and other survivors appear in the epilogue planting the French flag.

locations.name: Aurora Borealis Thin Place
locations.description: A dimensional weak point where the barrier between Earth and the colored worlds is thin. Only accessible during certain cosmic events. Ryan and Livia had their first date here, overlooking the aurora borealis. Ryan built a table here and constructed the Opis Armor.
locations.lore: Ryan used Resonators to open and hold a Thin Place for their date. He built the Opis Armor here across visits.

realms_and_dimensions.name: The Violet World (Purple World)
realms_and_dimensions.description: A compressed expanse of space and strange mirrors, overseen by an eerie inverted pyramid at its center. The realm of the Violet Ultimate One — the god of time and space. Ryan briefly accesses it and is observed by the pyramid.
realms_and_dimensions.lore: At the Perfect Run's end, the Violet pyramid manifests over New Rome and Ryan's Black Particles ascend toward it, suggesting the Ultimate One reclaims what it lent. A vision of a rabbit running in a purple world suggests the Plushie will meet Ryan there 'beyond the veil of time.'

realms_and_dimensions.name: The Blue World
realms_and_dimensions.description: A sphere of data, pictures, and numbers — a compendium of all knowledge that ever was, is, and will be. An azure godmind whose neural tendrils organize galaxy-sized libraries. The source of Blue Elixirs.
realms_and_dimensions.lore: Bacchus contacted the Blue Ultimate One during his Elixir consumption, which permanently affected his sanity and triggered his religious obsession. The alien Blue ooze that fused with Eva Fabre was a fragment of this world.

realms_and_dimensions.name: The Orange World
realms_and_dimensions.description: A Rubik's cube with countless stickers of every known inorganic matter — metals, liquids, gases — separated by orange lines. Adamantine sits at the center of one face, surrounded by all other metals, implying it is the ur-metal.
realms_and_dimensions.lore: The holographic display in the Alchemist's ship shows the Orange World with an ivory/adamantine sticker that Ryan and Leo Hargraves recognize as matching Augustus's body texture. This confirms Augustus as an Orange Genome.

realms_and_dimensions.name: The Green World
realms_and_dimensions.description: A pulsating living sphere that imitates a planet, where everything is alive — seas of green slime, teeth-mountains, blood vessel forests. Its poles open to reveal eyes and jagged tongues.
realms_and_dimensions.lore: Bloodstream glimpsed the Green World in his dreams long ago, referring to it as 'the Green Hell.' The experience foreshadowed his transformation into a viral entity.

realms_and_dimensions.name: The Red World
realms_and_dimensions.description: A crimson, vibrating storm of energy, lightning bolts, burning stars, and lights. A shining heart of nuclear chaos at its center — shaped like an eye that looks back at the observer.
realms_and_dimensions.lore: The Red World's burning eye-sun matches Leo Hargraves's solar nature. It is the most energetically violent of the colored worlds.

realms_and_dimensions.name: The Yellow World
